description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConnectionIssue detection logic within the OpenClaw project. It tests different conditions and expected issues related to gateway connection errors.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionIssueTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the detection of various gateway connection issues based on string messages.

methods.name: detectsTokenMissing
methods.description: Tests detection of a missing gateway token issue.

methods.name: detectsUnauthorized
methods.description: Tests detection of an unauthorized role error.

methods.name: detectsPairingWithRequestId
methods.description: Tests detection of pairing requirement with a specific request ID.

methods.name: detectsNetworkError
methods.description: Tests detection of a network-related error.

methods.name: returnsNoneForBenignStatus
methods.description: Ensures that a benign message like 'Connected' returns no issue.
